Second alpha. The project was consolidated into one codebase and the git history squashed; this is the first release built by CI.

## Play
Download the archive for your OS, unpack, run `ai-evolve` (`ai-evolve.exe` on Windows). The hero is AI-controlled; you are the level director:

- **1 / 2 / 3** — spawn an enemy / trap / chest next to the hero
- **Space / left mouse** — force an attack
- **Esc** — quit

The standalone build starts on the small dev map; run with `--full` for the full-size world. Logs are written to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AI-EVOLVE\output.log` (Windows) or the equivalent user data folder.

## What's new since v0.1.x
- Main menu (Russian UI), then the game world; boot goes through GameCore → SceneManager → plugins.
- Effects in combat: buffs/debuffs change combat stats, elite/boss hits slow, stealth attacks poison, damage-over-time respects death.
- Hero levels up from kills, opened chests and disarmed traps; enemies get stronger over time.
- `rust_core` (PyO3 0.29, Lua 5.5) builds on Windows, Linux and macOS; wheels for Python 3.14 are attached. The game does not use it yet.
- Python 3.14.
- Tooling: headless combat and boot tests in CI; `tools/dev_probe.py` now reports FAIL when the world is empty, frames are blank or errors are logged.

## Known limitations
- The hero's "learning" is still rule-based; counter-learning and enemy collective memory are next.
- Crowd control, toughness/stagger, item effects and the full damage pipeline (resistances, block, accuracy, penetration) exist in code but are not wired into the game yet.
- Only the Windows build was run by hand; the Linux and macOS builds come from CI and are untested on real machines. The macOS app is unsigned (right-click → Open the first time).
